title: lilium primulinum var. ochraceum
intro: Lilium primulinum var. ochraceum, commonly known as the pale yellow lily, is a subspecies of the Lilium primulinum species, a type of flowering plant in the lily family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its use in treating various health conditions such as fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, thanks to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Lilium primulinum var. ochraceum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which help in alleviating symptoms of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
